definitions.definition_word: An expressed word, phrase, concept or identifying reference whose meaning, definition or conceptual explanation is requested. A generic factual, biographical, appearance, spelling or specification query alone does not establish this role. Apply request-relevant scope.
definitions.personal_info: An explicitly expressed personal attribute or contact-information field, including a question asking for that attribute without supplying its value. Contact fields can belong to a person, group or organization. Mere person identity, possession, communication medium or an arbitrary event involving a person is insufficient. Apply request-relevant scope.
definitions.relation: An expressed kinship, interpersonal, social or occupational designation used to refer to a person/group or specify a relation between people. Generic personhood, celebrity status, ownership of an object or a bare personal-status field is insufficient. Apply request-relevant scope.

definition_word: Require a meaning/definition/concept-explanation relation and an expressed target. Define, what does X mean and what is X as a concept can establish it. What shape, appearance, specifications, biography or event facts alone do not.
Spelling, pronunciation, word origin or example usage alone are not meaning requests. If a usage request explicitly asks for meaning in context, the meaning role can be present independently.

Bare describe X may request conceptual explanation or surface description. Keep unavailable if that distinction is unsupported; explicit appearance-only requests are false. Do not use the native qa_definition label as evidence.

Deictic targets such as this word or define this can count when the meaning/definition operation is explicit. No target identity recovery is required; an unfinished meaning of with no target/reference is unavailable.
A semantic target can also satisfy another type only with that type's own expressed-role evidence. Mentioning the word doctor does not alone refer to an actual doctor.
personal_info: Count explicitly requested/stated personal attributes such as age, marital status, job title, department, residence or contact details. No supplied value is required. Contact address/number fields may have organizational owners.
Do not turn every statement about a person into a personal attribute: a name, bare recipient, social-role designation, possession of an object, or asking who participated in an event is insufficient.

An explicit attribute field and an explicit value may coexist with person, relation or email_address under independent definitions. Email as message medium or a standalone mailbox reference alone does not imply a separate attribute field.

Is X single or married explicitly asks marital status; who is X married to additionally expresses a spouse relation. My brother alone identifies a relative without independently requesting a personal attribute.
Contact wording with unclear message-versus-address reading stays unavailable; native labels never settle the ambiguity.
relation: Count explicitly used kinship or social roles such as mother, friend, boss, client, colleague or spouse, including occupational designations such as dentist used to identify a participant or group.
A role need not be relative to the speaker. Lawyers in a requested joke can be a professional group. A title considered only as a word/definition target does not alone identify people.

Bare single/married status without a spouse/partner role or relational endpoint belongs to personal_info, not automatically relation. Married to whom explicitly establishes a spouse relation even though the partner identity is unknown.
Generic person/celebrity status and possession such as my audiobook are not kinship, interpersonal or occupational designations. Bare company/bank/brand identity alone is not a designation of people.
A named profession used as a person designation may coexist with person. An explicit job-title field alone does not supply a particular occupational designation; assess the two roles separately.

negative_rule: Reviewed absence under complete input and current role policy; native omission is not absence.
ambiguity_rule: Keep unavailable for unsupported meaning-versus-description or field-versus-message interpretations.

upstream_evidence.interpretation: Examples distinguish contact fields, relatives and forensic as a definition target. The semantic narrowing and explicit role boundaries are project decisions, not official annotation equivalence.

evidence.reading: All432 native union and57 disjoint contrast reference texts read. Not all adjudicated, no independent certification or audio listening.

scope: Input-only task rules; no answer generation, knowledge lookup or gold-dependent question selection.
